title: Bases immediate upstream of the TATAAT box of the sigma 70 promoter of Escherichia coli significantly influence the activity of a model promoter by altering the bending angle of DNA.
authors: Sharma, Surbhi; Pant, Pradeep; Arya, Ranjana; Jayaram, Bhyravabhotla; Kumar Das, Hirendra
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟研究大肠杆菌sigma 70启动子间隔区碱基对DNA弯曲角的影响，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（启动子DNA结构）且用MD方法，但非直接TF-DNA结合建模，故评6分。
abstract: Different workers have found different bases of the spacer of the sigma 70 promoter of Escherichia coli to be important, depending on the base sequence of the two hexameric boxes of the naturally occurring promoter they were working on. Besides, there was no clue as to why particular bases worked better than others in particular positions. This necessitated a fresh look at the spacer region of a model promoter comprising all the consensus promoter elements. Randomisation of the three bases of the spacer in positions -15 to -13 with respect to the transcription initiation site, has elicited more than 50-fold variation in activity of the promoter, the highest and the lowest activities being 14,391(the three bases being GCA) and 264 Miller units (the three bases being AAA) respectively. Pairs of promoters of very similar activities were observed, even when the bases in these three positions were very different. The promoters with similar activities had similar three dimensional structures of the promoter DNA, as determined by molecular dynamics simulations. Randomisation of the three bases in positions -18 to -16 of the promoter that contained the triplet GCA in positions -15 to -13, resulted in promoters with highest activity of 15,759 (the triplet upstream of GCA being TAT) and lowest activity of 1,882 (the triplet upstream of GCA being AAA). Good correlation between the bending angles of the promoter DNAs and promoter activities could be observed, the R(2) value being 0.8724. Retardation of electrophoretic mobility of the promoter DNAs correlated well with activity.
abstract_zh: 不同研究者发现，大肠杆菌sigma 70启动子间隔区（spacer）的不同碱基具有重要性，这取决于他们所研究的天然启动子中两个六聚体框（hexameric boxes）的碱基序列。此外，对于特定位置上某些碱基为何优于其他碱基，没有线索可循。这促使我们对一个包含所有共有启动子元件的模型启动子的间隔区进行重新审视。对转录起始位点相对位置-15至-13的间隔区三个碱基进行随机化，导致启动子活性出现超过50倍的变异，最高和最低活性分别为14,391（三个碱基为GCA）和264 Miller单位（三个碱基为AAA）。即使在这三个位置上的碱基差异很大，也观察到活性非常相似的启动子对。具有相似活性的启动子，其启动子DNA的三维结构也相似，这是通过分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟确定的。对含有-15至-13位置GCA三联体的启动子中-18至-16位置的三个碱基进行随机化，得到的启动子最高活性为15,759（GCA上游的三联体为TAT），最低活性为1,882（GCA上游的三联体为AAA）。启动子DNA的弯曲角度与启动子活性之间可观察到良好相关性，R²值为0.8724。启动子DNA的电泳迁移率阻滞与活性良好相关。
